info.title: TradeWood agent API
info.description: Read-only API for AI agents and bots on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). Quotes swaps across Uniswap V2/V3/V4 via the Sherwood Router and the $WOOD seed sale, and returns unsigned transactions that the caller's own wallet signs and sends. No API key. Guide: https://tradewood.app/agents.md

get.summary: Endpoints, contract addresses and doc links
Listed tokens on Robinhood Chain (Uniswap token-list format). Use "ETH" for native ether.
Best route for a swap plus ready-to-sign approve/swap transactions
get.description: Send the returned transactions in order from `from`. An approve step (exact amount) appears only when the router's allowance is too low; wait for it to confirm before sending the swap. The swap reverts if output < minOut or after deadline. Re-quote if more than ~1 minute passes.

parameters.name: tokenIn
parameters.description: "ETH", a listed symbol (e.g. USDG, NVDA, cbBTC) or a token address

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Input amount in token units (decimal). Give this or amountIn.

parameters.name: amountIn
parameters.description: Input amount in integer base units

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Sender wallet. Needed for transactions, balance/allowance checks and gas estimate.

parameters.name: recipient
parameters.description: Receives the output. Defaults to from.

parameters.name: referrer
parameters.description: Bounty Bandits referrer address (recorded in the SherwoodSwap event)

parameters.name: allowUnlisted
parameters.description: Allow token addresses not on TradeWood's list. Verify the address first.

get.summary: $WOOD seed sale status, terms, a wallet's position and approve/buy/claim transactions
get.description: Only contribute for a user who has read `terms` and `disclosures` and explicitly asked to contribute a specific amount. Send approve (exact USDG), wait for confirmation, then buy.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet to report on and build transactions for

parameters.name: amountUsd
parameters.description: Contribution in USD (paid in USDG): $10 minimum total, $200 per wallet
